payload.text: ST0086 AC-02.2 and AC-02.6 arms, RULED by vc as proposed, owed before ST0086 closes. Order: v3 judge, ST0087 WP-03, ST0086 WP-03, then these. (1) read_endpoint takes a Source { security, curl, url }, and host_endpoint passes today's consts. Stub scripts in a tempdir: the security stub answers per -s (the naming condition both ways), the curl stub a canned status and body. One arm per EndpointFailure plus a bad body, fixture tokens only, never the real Keychain or api.anthropic.com. (2) Unit arms in intentd's census.rs: push past KEPT, held() arms ASKED, gather reads the endpoint only when asked; no interval knob. (3) Cite the parser and count arms against AC-02.2, add a cwd-attribution arm only where none measures it, and the reap arm is gather(true, _) calling prune.
